intro: North Agartala is where the city leaves the flat land along the Haora River and climbs into low hills. Its pages cover three localities. Kunjaban sits on a green hillock, with the palace of 1917 on its crest and the municipal North zone office at Kumari Tilla. Indranagar, close to Dhaleswar and Banamalipur, is known across the city for its Kali temple. Abhoynagar, also written Abhaynagar, holds a shrine dating from the late nineteenth century. Chanmari, Nandannagar and Radhanagar are other wards of the same zone, and homes across it mix houses on lanes with flats in buildings that have a gate.

For a tutor, the north is a compact zone with clear neighbours. Kunjaban lies just above the palace area in the centre, so tutors from the central wards come up the hill road as easily as those already living in the north. Indranagar and Abhoynagar share a pool of tutors with each other and with Banamalipur on the zone's southern edge. Most tutors ride a two-wheeler or take an auto. The calendar matters more than the map: the Diwali fair at the Indranagar temple and the spring festival at Abhoynagar fill local roads, so agree early which lessons move online on those dates.

When a family in the north sends a request, NXTutors builds the shortlist outward from the home: tutors living in the same locality, then tutors who say they travel to it, then the rest of Agartala, and online tutors after that. The family receives two or three matched tutors, can read each fee on the profile before booking, and starts with a free demo class at home. If the tutor stops suiting the child later in the year, switching to another costs nothing. For senior maths or physics, an online specialist can sit alongside a local tutor who covers the school subjects week to week.
faqs: Which localities does the North Agartala zone page cover?

Kunjaban, Indranagar and Abhoynagar have their own pages here. Chanmari, Nandannagar and Radhanagar are also North zone wards, so a family living in one of those can name the nearest of the three localities as a landmark when it sends a request, and the matching works the same way.
Does the hilly ground in North Agartala change how tutors travel?

Only a little. Agartala rises from the plains into low hills on its northern side, so homes up in Kunjaban are reached by a hill road rather than the flat streets of the centre. A two-wheeler handles that easily; the bigger factor is choosing a lesson hour that avoids office traffic heading towards the centre.
Which festival dates should North Agartala families plan around?

Two stand out. The Kali temple in Indranagar holds a three-day fair at Diwali, and Abhoynagar is the main venue in the state for an annual spring festival that the Tripura government recognised in 2015. Agree with the tutor in advance to move those days' lessons online or to an earlier hour.
Can a North Agartala family meet a tutor before paying for lessons?

Yes. The first class with any tutor matched through NXTutors is a free demo held at home, so your child can try the teaching before you agree to anything. You see the fee on the profile before booking, and moving to a different tutor later in the year is free.

intro: Central Agartala is the old core of the city, built around its palace, temples and markets. Its pages cover five localities. Krishnanagar is densely built and lies almost in the middle of the city, with Ujjayanta Palace, now the state museum, on its western side. Ramnagar is one of the earliest planned neighbourhoods in Tripura, a grid of about twelve numbered divisions. Banamalipur shares a ward with Dimsagar, Joynagar sits on the western side beside Battala Bazaar, and Melarmath lies on the flyover to southern Agartala. Ranjitnagar, Rajnagar, Shantipara and Town Pratapgarh are among the other central wards.

Homes here range from houses in long-settled lanes to flats in buildings with a gate, often just behind a row of shops. Tutors reach the zone from every direction by two-wheeler, auto or city bus, and the flyover brings those from Badharghat or Arundhutinagar straight into Melarmath. What slows a lesson is the clock rather than the route: the Tuesday and Friday market in Krishnanagar, evenings around Battala Bazaar, and office opening and closing on the main roads. Pick a slot that misses those, give a lane landmark rather than a market name, and plan online lessons for the Durga Puja immersion days near Joynagar.

Because the centre sits between the north, east and south zones, a central family's shortlist can draw on tutors coming from several directions. NXTutors starts with tutors in the same locality, moves on to those who travel there, then the rest of the city, then online tutors. Each request brings two or three matches, every fee is visible before you book, the first class is a free demo and switching later costs nothing. One useful habit at the demo: ask which route the tutor takes and at what hour, since that is the clearest guide to how regular the lessons will be through a busy term.
faqs: Which localities are on the Central Agartala zone page?

Krishnanagar, Ramnagar, Banamalipur, Joynagar and Melarmath. Wards such as Ranjitnagar, Rajnagar, Paschim Jaynagar, Shantipara and Town Pratapgarh also belong to the Central zone, so a family living in one of them can name the nearest of these five localities as its landmark when requesting a tutor.
What are the slowest times for tutors moving around Central Agartala?

Market evenings and office hours. Krishnanagar's weekly market runs on Tuesday and Friday, Battala Bazaar beside Joynagar is crowded through the day and busiest in the evening, and central roads fill as offices open and close. A lesson set clear of those times keeps the tutor on schedule all term.
Is it easier to give directions in some central localities than others?

Yes. Ramnagar's rectangular grid of numbered divisions means a division number and one landmark are usually enough. In Krishnanagar or Joynagar, where homes sit in lanes behind busy shopping streets, add a landmark in the lane itself, say whether it is a house or a flat, and share a phone number.
How much does a home tutor in Central Agartala cost?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Each tutor sets their own fee and shows it on the profile, so you know it before the free demo.

intro: East Agartala runs from Dhaleswar, next to Banamalipur at the edge of the centre, out to Jogendranagar on the eastern side of the city. Its pages cover three localities. Dhaleswar is a settled residential area with several schools, a post office and the municipal East zone office at Ashram Chowmuhani. Shibnagar is divided into two wards, Shibnagar and Paschim Shibnagar, and is known for a historic mosque with unusual architecture. Jogendranagar covers the most ground, spreading across the Jogendranagar, Uttar Jogendranagar and Purba Jogendranagar wards with Aralia alongside. Kashipur-Khayerpur is another ward of the zone.

The east is chiefly residential, and that shapes the timetable. In Dhaleswar, school opening and closing bring extra traffic, so later afternoon or early evening lessons run more smoothly. Directions usually hang on a chowmuhani, such as Ashram Chowmuhani or Math Chowmuhani, or on Station Road in Jogendranagar. Tutors move between the three localities by two-wheeler or auto. Jogendranagar also has its own railway station on the broad-gauge Lumding to Sabroom line, with passenger trains towards Agartala, which can suit a tutor who lives near the main station on the other side of the city.

A family in the east should check two things when it compares tutors: which ward each tutor lives in, and whether the trip crosses the centre at a busy hour. NXTutors helps with the first by looking at tutors in the same locality before anyone else, then at tutors who travel to it, then the rest of Agartala, then online. You get two or three matched tutors, see each fee before you book and begin with a free demo at home. If the arrangement stops working, a switch costs nothing, and an online tutor can take a specialist paper alongside a local one.
faqs: Which localities does the East Agartala zone page list?

Dhaleswar, Shibnagar and Jogendranagar have their own pages. Kashipur-Khayerpur, Paschim Shibnagar, Uttar Jogendranagar, Purba Jogendranagar and Aralia are also East zone wards, so a family living there can use the closest of the three as a landmark when asking for a tutor through the site.
When is a good time for home lessons in East Agartala?

Later afternoon or early evening, in most cases. Dhaleswar has several schools, and their opening and closing hours bring extra traffic to local roads. A slot after that rush suits the tutor's trip and gives the child a short break after school before the lesson starts.
Can tutors use the train to reach East Agartala?

Some can. Jogendranagar railway station, opened in 2008 and rebuilt in 2016, is on the broad-gauge Lumding to Sabroom line with passenger trains towards Agartala. Most tutors still travel by two-wheeler or auto, so a landmark near Station Road or a chowmuhani helps them more than the timetable does.
Does an East Agartala family have to stay with the first tutor it tries?

No. Switching tutor through NXTutors is free at any point, and each request returns two or three matched tutors to choose from. Fees are shown before you book, and the opening class is a free demo, so you can judge the fit before regular lessons begin.

intro: South Agartala is the city's gateway by rail. Agartala railway station, opened in 2008, rebuilt for broad gauge in 2016 and the main station for the city, is listed at Badharghat, with trains on the Lumding to Sabroom line and long-distance services. The zone's pages cover three localities. Badharghat, also written Badarghat, forms the Bhattapukur-Badarghat and Dakkhin Badarghat wards and has the municipal South zone office near the TV Centre. Arundhutinagar covers two wards. Pratapgarh's Paschim and Purba wards sit in this zone, while Town Pratapgarh belongs to the centre. Bardowali, Siddhi Ashram and Rajlaxminagar are other South zone wards.

Two pieces of infrastructure shape tuition here. The flyover, opened in 2019, starts at Police Lines in southern Agartala and runs to Fire Brigade Chowmuhani in the centre, so tutors from the central wards can come south, and southern tutors can head north, on one direct link. The station, by contrast, adds traffic around train times near Badharghat. Because Arundhutinagar and Pratapgarh are each split across wards, an address needs the ward name as well as a landmark; the Baptist church in Arundhutinagar, dating from the 1930s, is one that many people here know.

For a southern family, the practical choice is often between a tutor from the same cluster of wards and one who uses the flyover from the centre. NXTutors shortlists in that order: tutors in your locality first, then those who travel to it, then the rest of Agartala, then online tutors for subjects a local tutor cannot cover. Two or three matched tutors come back for each request, each fee is listed before booking, the first class is a free demo, and if the match fades later, switching costs nothing. Ask each tutor at the demo how they will travel and at what hour.
faqs: Which localities are covered by the South Agartala zone page?

Badharghat, Arundhutinagar and Pratapgarh. Bardowali, Siddhi Ashram and Rajlaxminagar are also South zone wards, and families living there can give the nearest of these three as a landmark. Note that Town Pratapgarh is a Central zone ward, while Paschim and Purba Pratapgarh sit in the South zone.
Does the flyover matter for tuition in South Agartala?

Yes. Opened in 2019, it runs from Police Lines in the south to Fire Brigade Chowmuhani in the centre, passing through Melarmath. That gives tutors living in the central wards a quicker route to Badharghat, Arundhutinagar and Pratapgarh, and widens the set of tutors a southern family can realistically consider.
Should South Agartala families plan lessons around train times?

Near Badharghat it helps. Agartala railway station is listed there, and the station area brings extra traffic around train times. If your home is close to it, agree a lesson hour that avoids the busiest arrivals, and allow a little margin on the first visit while the tutor learns the route.
What does a South Agartala family get when it sends a request?

Two or three matched tutors, chosen nearest first: your own locality, then tutors who travel there, then the rest of Agartala, then online. Every fee is on the profile before you book, the first class is a free demo, and switching to someone else later is free.
